name: My Bashful Fox Hubby
original_name: 在逃99次，我的九尾狐老公追红温了
overview: Jiang Nuan is betrayed by her uncle's family and falls off a cliff, only to be saved by the millennia-old nine-tailed fox Yun Qi at the brink of death. Little does she know he is actually there to finish her off. After being killed and reborn three times, the exasperated Nuan kisses Qi, accidentally swallowing his inner core and altering her fate. Seeing his peerless beauty and immense power, she clings to this life-saving ally, flirting shamelessly to survive while using his power to reclaim her billion-dollar inheritance from her wicked uncle. When she discovers that his three murder attempts are actually acts of salvation, their love blossoms, turning the loop of death into a triumphant tale.
